nina: Heads-up — onboarding Orbiton-13B (converted from Gemma+Llama). Quick smoke on int4 quant showed generation divergence vs fp16 on long-context summarization. Suspect rotary/KV-cache aliasing. Repro below :eyes:

nina: repro (short):
```python
# run on staging container
python -c "from ri import loader; m=loader.load('orbiton-13b:int4'); print(m.generate('Summarize: ...', max_tokens=128))"
```

sam: saw same. Logs show repeated tokens and sudden context collapse at ~512 tokens.

aj: can you paste the kvcache dump? maybe token ids shifted or rotary theta mismatch.

nina: kvcache excerpt:
```
KV_HEAD_0[0..8] = [0.131, -0.002, 0.004, 0.129, -0.110, ...]
...alignment mismatch offset=1
```

maria: benchmark quick numbers (summarize testset):
- fp16: avg ROUGE-L 0.42, PPL 12.3
- int4 (default conv): avg ROUGE-L 0.35, PPL 19.8
regression mostly after 400 tokens.

aj: hypothesis: tokenizer mapping applied a +1 id shift during conversion (we saw this with another Gemma convert). Also check rotary base (freq) — Gemma vs Llama headdim layout may mismatch.

sam: run this quick diff:
```bash
# verify tokenizer map
ri.tools.tokcheck --src gemma-vocab.json --dst orbiton-vocab.json --report
# check rotary params
ri.tools.rotcheck --model orbiton-13b --expected rotary_base=10000
```

nina: ran tokcheck — 3 ids mapped to sentinel positions (0x202). rotcheck shows rotary_base=8192 (converted), but our runtime expects 10000.

aj: that explains phase drift. Two options:
1) re-export with rotary_base=10000
2) add runtime shim to rescale rotary angles on load (cheap)

maria: quick eval with runtime shim (patched in staging) improved ROUGE-L to 0.40, PPL 13.9. Still slightly below fp16 but acceptable for now.

liam: can we add an auto-detect to conversion pipeline? if tokenizer map has sentinel remap or rotary_base mismatch, fail conversion and surface diff.

nina: yes — filing a follow-up ticket. For immediate rollouts, suggest setting model routing rule to fall back to gemma-13b-fp16 for long requests >1024 tokens.

devops-bot: deploy: staging/rotary-shim v0.2 — succeeded :white_check_mark:

sam: thanks. I'll schedule a canary with traffic split 5% -> orbiton-int4, 95% -> gemma-fp16 tomorrow.

maria: logging prompt evals to console->s3; I'll watch hallucination rate.

nina: thanks all. filing conversion PR and ticket: GH#1256
